summary: Expose per-person thread unread reminders with return anchors in client-v0

replay.detail: This API adapter introduces no store replay rules; the companion thread-reading store patch supplies persistence.

schema.detail: Add thread.mark-unread and thread.clear-unread actions with idempotency keys and captured observed_marks, plus ThreadSummary.unread_reminder with all active marks and the canonical primary return anchor. Mark IDs are opaque stable signed operation IDs, never claim IDs. Existing thread.list accepts exclusive marked_unread=true; thread.timeline accepts around instead of cursor and returns optional previous_cursor and anchor resolution state.

rules.detail: Reminder writes require control.messages and the acting person. Existing summary reads and feeds retain their read grant. Natural message unread and read history are unchanged; unobserved concurrent marks are preserved.

compatibility.detail: Generated Rust, Swift, and TypeScript clients expose the new actions and optional summary reminder. Auto-clear only captured mark IDs whose own anchor was deliberately viewed on a later visit; the current visit stays sticky.
